description: Makes or changes the creator's media kit; fields left out keep their value. published true puts it at chockstonelabs.com/k/<slug> for anyone with the link (not listed or searchable); false hides it. sections turns parts on or off (numbers, top_posts, results, brands, rates). pinned_post_ids (up to 6, from kit_get's posts) lead the Top posts part in that order. Numbers are never typed in here: they come from the accounts and the results. Undo puts the kit back as it was.

about.description: A few lines brands read about the creator and who follows them; null uses their profile's pitch, then the link page's bio

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

headline.description: One line under the name, e.g. "Anesthesia resident teaching med school study habits"; null clears it

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

slug.description: The kit's address, chockstonelabs.com/k/<slug>: 2 to 30 lowercase letters, numbers, dashes or underscores

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: kit_update
title: Change the media kit
